description: The file defines an interface for a message consumer client in the Eclipse Hono project, outlining methods for closing the consumer, flowing credits, and retrieving remaining credits.

classes.name: MessageConsumer
classes.description: An interface for consuming messages from a Hono server, including methods for closing the connection, managing message flow, and checking remaining credits.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the AMQP link with the Hono server, invoking the provided handler with the result.

methods.name: flow
methods.description: Grants a specified number of message credits to the sender; throws IllegalStateException if prefetch is non-zero or a drain operation is in progress.

methods.name: getRemainingCredit
methods.description: Returns the number of additional messages the consumer can receive, valid during the current Vert.x handler execution.
